summary: Validated /app/balans-theme.zip as a WordPress theme package. Zip is well-formed: single top-level directory 'balans-theme/', style.css present at depth 2 (balans-theme/style.css) which is exactly what WordPress expects on upload. style.css contains a valid WP theme header (Theme Name: Balans, Version: 1.0.0, License: GPL v2 or later, plus Author, Description, Text Domain, Tags, Requires at least, Tested up to, Requires PHP). All required templates (functions.php, index.php, header.php, footer.php) exist at depth 1 inside balans-theme/. No preview/, no .DS_Store, no __MACOSX, no dev artifacts. All 32 .php files pass `php -l` with no syntax errors. The 'stylesheet is missing / De stylesheet (style.css) ontbreekt' error should NOT occur with this zip.
critical_code_review_comments: Zip structure is correct: single root folder 'balans-theme/' with style.css at depth 2 matches WordPress's expected unpack layout.
style.css WP theme header is complete and valid (Theme Name, Version, License, License URI, Text Domain, Tags, Requires PHP, Tested up to all present).
All 32 PHP files pass php8.2 syntax lint (php -l) with no errors.
No junk files (__MACOSX, .DS_Store, preview/) in archive — clean deliverable.

Required templates (index.php, functions.php, header.php, footer.php, style.css) plus a healthy set of extras (front-page.php, archive.php, single.php, search.php, 404.php, page.php, searchform.php, page-templates/*, inc/*, woocommerce/, template-parts/, languages/, assets/) are all packaged correctly.
seed_data_creation: Extracted zip to /tmp/wptest for validation (temp only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deliverable is a WordPress theme zip (not a running app). Validation is purely structural (zip layout, style.css header, PHP syntax). No HTTP endpoints or UI to test. If user still reports 'stylesheet is missing' after re-uploading this exact zip, the cause is on the WordPress side (e.g., web server upload size limit truncating the zip, or user uploaded a different file) — not the archive itself.
rca of the issue: User saw 'De stylesheet (style.css) ontbreekt.' when uploading. That error is raised by WordPress's Theme_Upgrader when, after unpacking the uploaded zip, it cannot find a style.css directly inside the single top-level folder (depth 2 from zip root). Confirmed via extraction simulation: `unzip /app/balans-theme.zip -d /tmp/wptest` yields exactly `/tmp/wptest/balans-theme/style.css`, which is the correct layout. The current /app/balans-theme.zip will NOT trigger this error. Likely root cause for the user's report: (a) they uploaded an older/different build, (b) upload was truncated due to PHP upload_max_filesize / post_max_size on their host, or (c) they re-zipped the extracted folder on macOS, which produces a double-nested 'balans-theme/balans-theme/' or adds __MACOSX. Mitigation: re-download /app/balans-theme.zip as-is and upload without re-zipping; if it still fails, raise upload_max_filesize/post_max_size in php.ini on the target WordPress host, or install via FTP by uploading the extracted 'balans-theme' folder directly into wp-content/themes/.
